name: Glass Monk

Traits.name: Keening Refraction
Traits.text: When a creature hits the glass monk with a melee attack, The attacker takes 17 (5d6) Thunder damage as the resonant lattice returns a portion of the blow.
Traits.clause: When a creature hits the glass monk with a melee attack, the lattice rings and shivers, splitting the blow back along th
Traits.expresses: turning every blow back on the striker
Traits.expressedQuote: the resonant lattice returns a portion of the blow.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The glass monk makes two attacks, using Unarmed Strike or Dart in any combination.

Actions.name: Unarmed Strike
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Once on each of the glass monk's turns when it hits with this attack, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 17. *Failure:* The target has the Stunned condition until the end of the glass monk's next turn.

Actions.name: Dart
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, range 20/60 ft. 29 (6d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Patient Defense
Bonus Actions.text: The glass monk takes the Dodge action.

Bonus Actions.name: Cunning Action
Bonus Actions.text: The glass monk takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

lore: Fused from the shards of a shattered monastery bell by a glasswright seeking a guardian that could not be blamed for its own violence, the Glass Monk keeps its silent vigil, waiting for a pilgrim worthy enough to strike first.
